blurb: A small palace with some of the best Dutch paintings of all.

facts.t: Vermeer painted her around 1665. She is not a portrait but a tronie, a study of a face in an exotic turban. Nobody knows who sat for it.

src.n: Wikipedia: Girl with a Pearl Earring

facts.t: In 1632 the young Rembrandt painted the Amsterdam surgeons' guild watching Dr Nicolaes Tulp dissect a hanged thief's arm. It made his name.

src.n: Wikipedia: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp
